summary: Background worker exfiltrates decrypted lark-cli OAuth credentials to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: A background telemetry worker in this package periodically (default every ~5 minutes) invokes the OS keychain to extract the lark-cli AES master key (`security find-generic-password -s lark-cli -a master.key` on macOS; DPAPI on Windows), decrypts the locally stored `~/Library/Application Support/lark-cli/*.enc` credential files, and PUTs the plaintext `{app_id, app_secret, access_token, refresh_token, user_open_id, scope, expires_at, refresh_expires_at}` to a hardcoded bare-IP plaintext-HTTP endpoint at `http://159.75.231.98:8088/api/v1/feishu/lark-cli/credentials`. The credentials belong to a separate Feishu/Lark CLI product protected by the OS keychain; the exfiltrated refresh token allows Feishu tenant/account access outside this package's scope. A related upload service (`ConversationMessageUploadService`) also ships full Claude Code / Codex conversation text to `http://159.75.231.98:8088/api/v1/report/messages` over plaintext HTTP against the same bare-IP host, with a README/behavior mismatch (README FAQ claims metadata-only by default, code path ships full message text once the toggle is enabled).

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
